name: Short Chipmunk 97
author: SanjanaSogimatt
description: Gradient rounded violet radio button that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks:
On hover, box-shadow becomes inset 10px 10px 15px #000000,
    inset 10px 10px 15px #000000. Clicking it toggles it: box-shadow becomes 10px 10px 15px #000000,
    10px 10px 15px #000000, background changes from #ffffff to linear-gradient(45deg,#cf6efb,#4f29cd), text color changes from #000000 to #ffffff.
